changes.after: Read DOCX, DOC, RTF, Markdown, and plain text files by passing a file path to the Document constructor, where the reader is selected automatically based on the file extension, with DOCX parsing implemented as a pure-Python parser built on the standard library zipfile module, DOC and RTF files delegated to the OLE2 path via olefile, and Markdown parsing supporting headings, lists, emphasis, tables, block quotes, code blocks, links, and embedded images as document-model nodes.
